category_title: Students focused on task completion with accuracy and partially effective self-regulation
scenario_title: Reading comprehension help-seeking and goal modification
minimal_context: The student is working on a reading comprehension task during an individualized support session.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's start the reading comprehension task. Please read the passage and answer the questions at the end.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Okay. I'm trying to use the reading strategies we talked about. I asked myself, do I understand what the information is saying? But I'm not really sure if I'm doing it right.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep trying to read through it.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Can you help me? I want to make sure my answers are accurate so I can get a good grade and avoid failing, but I don't know how to find the right information.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Fine, I'll just write down whatever to finish the task. I'm not going to try to understand it anymore because everything …confusing.
